name: BambooHR Café (Thomas2Go) Grill Station: Plain Smashburger or Grilled Chicken Sandwich
brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Café at BambooHR (Lindon, UT)
whyItWorks: Ordering a fresh-off-the-grill herb-free chicken breast or single beef patty with aged cheddar or Swiss on a soft brioche/potato bun at the BambooHR café grill station avoids the hidden garlic, citrus dressings, and spicy sauces in daily specials.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the grill cook for a plain Grilled Chicken Breast or Single Cheeseburger with cheddar or Swiss on a soft bun—skip raw red onion, tomato, pickles, and chipotle/garlic aioli.
watchOuts: Skip seasoned curly/waffle fries if coated in paprika/onion batter; pair with a banana or plain kettle chips
